# model-viewer

Vendored from the official npm package @google/model-viewer, version 4.3.1.
Source: https://github.com/google/model-viewer
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/model-viewer/v/4.3.1
License: Apache-2.0, included in model-viewer-LICENSE.txt.

The bundled module includes its runtime dependencies. The employee ID uses an
uncompressed GLB with embedded textures, so no remote decoder or environment
asset is required at runtime.
